hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a single AGL/USDC pool that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the hook itself, permanently locking all liquidity. afterSwap records a transient AGL quota (via tstore) used by the AGL token contract to gate token transfers in and out of the PoolManager. Collects a fixed 2% LP fee withdrawable only by a designated fee recipient.
